description: This file defines the ImplicitChannelSubscriberTable class, which manages implicit subscriptions for broadcast channels in Orleans. It includes methods for building and caching subscription data, retrieving implicit subscribers, and creating grain references for subscribers.

classes.name: ImplicitChannelSubscriberTable
classes.description: Manages implicit subscriptions for broadcast channels, including cache management, subscriber retrieval, and grain reference creation.

classes.name: ImplicitChannelSubscriberTable.BroadcastChannelSubscriberPredicate
classes.description: Associates a subscriber with a namespace predicate for filtering implicit subscribers.

classes.name: ImplicitChannelSubscriberTable.BroadcastChannelSubscriber
classes.description: Represents a subscriber with associated grain bindings and methods to generate grain IDs.

classes.name: ImplicitChannelSubscriberTable.Cache
classes.description: Holds cached data including version, predicates, and namespace-to-subscriber mappings.

methods.name: ImplicitChannelSubscriberTable
methods.description: Constructor initializing the subscriber table with bindings, providers, and service provider.

methods.name: GetCache
methods.description: Retrieves the current cache, rebuilding it if the bindings have changed.

methods.name: BuildCache
methods.description: Builds a new cache based on the current bindings and version.

methods.name: GetImplicitSubscribers
methods.description: Returns a dictionary of subscriber GUIDs to consumer extensions for a given channel ID.

methods.name: GetOrAddImplicitSubscribers
methods.description: Retrieves or creates the set of implicit subscribers for a given namespace.

methods.name: MakeSubscriptionGuid
methods.description: Creates a unique GUID for a subscription based on grain type and channel ID.

methods.name: FindImplicitSubscribers
methods.description: Finds all subscribers matching a namespace predicate.

methods.name: MakeConsumerReference
methods.description: Creates a grain reference for a subscriber to support broadcast channel extension.
